doc: ITR Showcase loot manifest. Custom loot tags with tiered budgets (never the vanilla zone tags, whose budgets are save-wide) and custom generator IDs. The loader reads it at startup and adds each tag to the game config's LootArray (TMap add: key = tag, LootTable = the stock DataTable of source_tag, whose used points are shared with that zone; LootPoints = loot_points). While the map is loaded, the loader points each entry at the map's DataTable named by table_name / table_asset (held by BP_ItrShowcase_LootTables), and back at the stock table when the map goes. A tag that takes the shared mod framework's loot slots (47 of them: not the artifact, G2 and signature tags) has three composite tables, table_variants {V, SC, ST}: the base table (base_table, the tier recipe) plus the framework's 11 user slot tables of the matching stock table; the loader picks the set at load from the live game config. table_name / table_asset name the V composite. source_tag_points is the stock budget of source_tag.
budget_rule: loot_points = max(1, round(source_zone_budget * scale)); source_zone_budget = sum of the source zone's area tags of that category (e.g. Buffer Ammo = BlockPost 24 + CarDepot 20 + TrainStation 32); scale = the tier's footprint in hectares / the source zone's footprint in hectares. Stash.* tags are zone-wide in 2.7.2 and scale the same way; a stash tag's budget is never below the points of the stash nodes placed on it.

tables_doc: Table rows come from the map generator's loot tier recipes; the donor in source_tag/datatable is the fallback when a pak lacks the table. Tags with tier SIG.<id> are the signature stashes of the map's strange spots.
generator_rule: max(1, round(footprint_ha * 0.19)) IDs per area (2.7.2: 0.12-0.19 generators per footprint ha)
